scientific_scope: Finite Herschel graph with each of its three degree-four tie-capable vertices individually selectable for preferential tie resolution; all 8 subsets covered.

value.rationale: Selective deterministic opinion bias at all tie-capable vertices of a canonical eleven-vertex polyhedral graph provides a natural intervention family rather than arbitrary parameter slices. The entire eight-rule finite classification reveals a surprising and strictly quantified suppression of total consensus even while the favored consensus grows, plus nonmonotone two-cycle populations and a sharp relaxation change. The exact statewise certificate is useful as a benchmark for the effect of heterogeneous tie policies.
